points: \textbf{Talk-to-Genie Platform} --- Built an external web application integrating Databricks Genie using OAuth-based authentication, enabling secure access outside Databricks with conversational interaction support.
\textbf{Unified Genie Architecture} --- Designed a scalable RAG framework overcoming Databricks Genie's \textbf{30-table limitation} by organizing \textbf{120+ tables} across \textbf{9 Genie spaces}.
\textbf{Intelligent Query Routing Engine} --- Built semantic retrieval pipelines using table and column metadata to dynamically route prompts to relevant Genie spaces.
\textbf{Near Real-Time Data Pipeline} --- Built ADF ingestion pipelines supporting \textbf{15-minute refresh cycles} with Landing $\rightarrow$ Bronze $\rightarrow$ Silver transformations.

projects.title: CareerOS
points: \textbf{AI Job Discovery Engine} --- Built an end-to-end platform extracting job postings from LinkedIn, Indeed and Telegram and generating tailored resumes based on job requirements.

\textbf{Multi-Agent LLM Workflow} --- The platform extracts job postings, gives a probability of the candidate getting the job, and creates customised resumes for each job posting based on the job description.
\textbf{Resume Automation Dashboard} --- Developed an interactive dashboard with analytics, workflow execution and downloadable resume generation.

projects.title: GAN-Based Data Augmentation for Imbalanced Datasets
points: \textbf{Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline} --- Built an end-to-end augmentation framework using Custom GAN and SMOTE to address class imbalance in tabular datasets. Used Credit cards dataset as a usecase (10000000+ Data points).

\textbf{Custom GAN Architecture} --- Designed Generator ($128 \rightarrow 256 \rightarrow 512$, Tanh) and Discriminator ($512 \rightarrow 256 \rightarrow 128 \rightarrow 1$) networks with Xavier initialization, LeakyReLU activations and BatchNorm for stable tabular GAN training.
\textbf{Multi-Model Training Framework} --- Implemented ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting) on real data and real+augmented data using 5-fold cross-validation.
\textbf{Performance Improvement} --- Brought down False Negatives to just 9 in a dataset containing 10000000+ data points, Recall value increased from 0.91 to 0.99.

projects.title: Tinder AI Coach
projects.tech_stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, Ollama
points: \textbf{Web-Based Profile Automation} --- Built a FastAPI dashboard where users manage and update their entire Tinder profile (bio, prompts and photos) from one place; the system standardizes and optimizes the inputs and writes them back to the live account, so users never open the Tinder app directly.

\textbf{Multimodal Photo Analysis} --- Integrated Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) to analyze profile photos and return actionable feedback on composition, presentation, lighting, background and photo selection.

\textbf{India Dating Knowledge Base} --- Web-scraped and curated data on the Indian dating landscape (profile norms, preferences and photo best-practices) into a knowledge base that grounds the coach's profile and messaging advice in the local context.
